newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish cabinet to debate telecom sale on May 13.
newsitem.headline: Polish cabinet to debate telecom sale on May 13.

text.p: Poland's government will discuss the method of privatising the country's telecom monopoly TPSA at its session on May 13, the government spokeswoman, Aleksandra Jakubowska, said on Monday.
"This privatisation will be discussed on Tuesday next week," she told a news briefing.

Earlier this month, Prime Minister Wlodzimierz Cimoszewicz said the cabinet would decide on how quickly TPSA should be sold, how big a stake should be retained by the treasury and whether to offer shares to a strategic investor or only float some on bourses.
He said the sell-off was unlikely to begin in 1997.
